_comment_zh: closure 商店對話（販售一般商店）

node_2.text_zh: 博士!你身上有一股很香的味道

node_3.text: You know what? I prefer the smell of engine oil over blood!
node_3.text_zh: 你知道嗎!比起鮮血我更喜歡機油的味道!

node_4.text: Once, there was an engine oil-scented blood bag available. I was a big fan, but they stopped making it because it didn't sell well.
node_4.text_zh: 曾經市面上有一款機油味血袋，我挺喜歡的，可是後來因為銷量不佳而停產了。

node_5.text: As a blood demon, I always feel out of place among my own kind. Maybe that's why I keep dreaming about that engine oil-scented blood bag...
node_5.text_zh: 身為一位血魔，我感覺我跟我的同胞總是格格不入，或許是因為這樣，我總是夢見那個機油味的血袋......
